source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension - Agricultural Extension Bulletin (ព្រឹត្តិបត្រផ្សព្វផ្សាយកសិកម្ម), Vol.01 Issue 01, January 2015 - farmer success story on banana chip processing
text:
This Department of Agricultural Extension bulletin (MAFF, Vol.01 Issue 01, January 2015) profiles farmer Duy Samat of Chres village, Me Sang district, Prey Veng province, who built a small household business processing local banana (ចេកចាស់) into fried banana chips (ផលិតផលចេកសាប). He originally grew other cash crops before turning to banana processing as a value-added income source, drawing on locally grown fruit rather than fruit that would otherwise be sold fresh at a lower price.

The bulletin documents his production steps and household economics as a model for other farmers interested in adding value to banana through simple, low-cost home processing rather than relying only on fresh-fruit sales, which fetch a lower price and are more vulnerable to spoilage and price swings at harvest peak.
